MonitoringProgramDescription: A monitoring program to track the non-degradation of subalpine conifer species, including the endangered whitebark pine.
MonitoringApproach: Ground-based plot data that inform remote sensing techniques to track change over time in species composition, health, and distribution in the subalpine zone.
